name: Door burst title
what: A small white double door stands open in the dark; the camera rushes in through it, a glint of yellow text in the opening explodes out over the door as a huge line, settles, is whipped away to the right and swapped for a final title that slides in and rests with a slight float.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f7 the camera pushes into the open door (zoom x1 -> x6, accelerating); f3-f5 a glint of text in the opening grows x3 a frame as a smeared streak; f6 it bursts out over the door at x2.3 its size and holds with a jolt to f13; f13-f20 it settles to its size; f20-f36 it slides right (S-curve); f36-f39 it is pulled back left with heavy smear; f40 it is swapped for the final title, which slides in from the right and decelerates to rest by f52; then it floats and tilts a little

tracks.name: door push
tracks.what: the camera zooms through the open door; its leaves fly out of the frame

tracks.name: glint
tracks.what: a streak of text in the opening grows x3 a frame, smeared sideways

tracks.name: burst
tracks.what: the text is huge over the door and holds, jolting

tracks.name: settle
tracks.what: the text shrinks to its size

tracks.name: slide right
tracks.what: the text slides to the right

tracks.name: swap
tracks.what: the text is pulled back left with heavy smear and replaced by the final title, which slides in and rests

tracks.name: float
tracks.what: the final title tilts and drifts a few px
